data_issues: Labels y are off by one relative to the stimulus log: in both train and val, every trial with movie_time_s = t has y = (t-21) mod 10 instead of t-20 (e.g. movie time 20 s is labeled 9, 21 s labeled 0, ..., 29 s labeled 8). This is a consistent cyclic label shift (all 150 labeled trials). I relabeled using movie_time_s - 20 (matching classes.json) before training. No duplicate trials across splits found.
